dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Barona Group of Capitan Grande Band of Mission Indians, local federal land management agency personnel, and members of the public utilizing the specified land.
dimensions.evidence: To take certain land in the State of California into trust for the benefit of the Barona Group of Capitan Grande Band of Mission Indians of the Barona Reservation, California, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Local land transfer affecting ownership status and tribal administration over approximately 836 total acres.
dimensions.evidence: administrative jurisdiction of Parcel 2 and Parcel 3 is transferred to the Secretary; and the covered land is taken into trust for the benefit of an Indian Tribe.

dimensions.assessment: No significant federal spending or revenue implications are stated or implied beyond administrative transfer costs.
Narrow, site-specific legislation altering land status and management jurisdiction for specific parcels in San Diego County, California.
dimensions.evidence: The term 'Parcel 1' means the approximately 160 acres of land administered by the Bureau of Land Management

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change in trust status and reservation boundaries for the affected land parcels.
dimensions.evidence: The land taken into trust under subsection (a) shall be part of the reservation of the Tribe;

missing_information: Specific administrative or operational costs to the federal government for executing the land transfer.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill transfers administrative jurisdiction of specific federal parcels in California into trust for the benefit of one specific Indian Tribe, impacting local land administration and public access rights without broad federal fiscal or programmatic changes.
